description: This file defines the SheetViewOptions class, which is responsible for parsing and applying view-related options for a worksheet within an XLSX spreadsheet using the PhpSpreadsheet library. It reads XML elements related to sheet properties and configures the worksheet object accordingly.

classes.name: SheetViewOptions
classes.description: Class responsible for loading and applying sheet view options from the worksheet XML in an XLSX file.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worksheet and optional worksheet XML.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the sheet view options from the XML and applies them to the worksheet.

methods.name: tabColor
methods.description: Sets the tab color for the worksheet if specified.

methods.name: codeName
methods.description: Sets the code name for the worksheet if specified.

methods.name: outlines
methods.description: Configures outline display options based on XML attributes.

methods.name: pageSetup
methods.description: Configures page setup options like 'fit to page'.

methods.name: sheetFormat
methods.description: Sets default row height and column width based on XML attributes.

methods.name: printOptions
methods.description: Configures print and gridline options for the worksheet.
